62179.name: Custodian Field · Retaliation
62179.SpecificEffects:
Activates Aura: Allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile take <color=#F74848>25%</color> less DMG from Tactical attacks. Similar effects cannot stack.
When allies within <color=#F74848>1</color> adjacent tile are hit by a Missile attack, the <color=#F74848>1st</color> missile is unable to hit. This effect can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per sortie.
When retaliating, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
ST Body HP <color=#F74848>+10%</color>.
